objective: Provide a Markdown-first Delivery Control Room that keeps session, daily action, plan, backlog, decisions, risks, evidence, handoff, scorecard and research state recoverable without chat history.
completed: Registered ten small Markdown control-room views with explicit status, owner, source, update date and deterministic order
Enforced exactly one primary action and timezone-aware freshness for dated operational snapshots
Built a standard-library generator that escapes raw HTML, rejects unsafe links and produces a committed static HTML projection
Added navigation, search, view filters, freshness warnings, print support, responsive layout, accessible labels and light/dark themes
Linked the control room from the guide home page without changing the shared stylesheet, script, workflow or continuity validator
Added sixteen control-room tests covering source contracts, unsafe input, local references, semantics, checkpoint shape and source/display drift
Declared the PR #30 continuity divergence so a receiving agent does not mistake baseline NS-026 for current work
remaining: Publish the branch and open a draft pull request stacked on PR #28
Obtain a successful GitHub Actions validation run on the final head SHA
Independent human review and merge after PR #28 is accepted or the branch is safely retargeted
Compose or merge PR #30 so badf/current-state.json emits NS-001 rather than obsolete NS-026
Repository administrator enables GitHub Pages and retains deployment evidence

validation.command: node --check script.js and generated control-room inline JavaScript
GitHub Actions validation on final WP-018 head SHA

observations: The baseline continuity validator passes structurally but emits stale NS-026; PR #30 documents and corrects that factual drift independently on main
Naming the shell template with an .html extension made the site validator treat it as a deployable page; the .tpl boundary fixes that without weakening or modifying the validator
Placing the generated page under stages keeps the existing all-pages negative control meaningful: its gutted-site fixture removes every secondary page before asserting that no references remain
The control room is an evidence-linked projection, not a second mutable issue tracker and not proof that the underlying facts remain current
decisions: Markdown is the authoritative control-room content and the HTML page is reproducible committed output
No runtime Markdown library or live GitHub API is required for the static page
Exactly one section may declare primary true; conflicting source state fails the build
Expired snapshots remain visible but are marked stale instead of being presented as current
Shared files owned by other open pull requests remain untouched
assumptions: PR #28 remains the correct architecture documentation base until it is merged or explicitly rejected
PR #30 remains the valid correction for the stale continuity primary action until a newer attributable record supersedes it
GitHub Pages continues to publish every tracked .html file through the existing artifact workflow

blockers.resolution: Select GitHub Actions as the Pages source, run the push workflow and retain the successful deployment URL.
Complete and accept the S01 tenant authority profile before advancing architecture slices.
Review the final head SHA and merge only after its stacked base is accepted or safely retargeted.

recovery.first_safe_command: python3 -B scripts/build_control_room.py --check && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v
stop_if: The generated HTML differs from the Markdown build
More than one section declares primary true
PR #28 or PR #30 materially changed and the control-room sources have not been reconciled
A shared file is now owned by another uncomposed pull request
A requested action requires merge, repository administration, architecture acceptance or production authority

declared_non_coverage: No architecture decision or ADR is accepted by this Work Package
